notes: Market shocks the sim applies on fixed dates (design thread, 26 Sep 2026). Uri is hard-coded here rather than waiting for its event card: for one week, power on INDEX contracts costs index_price_mult times as much, unless the player curtails (the grid asks the week before, like a curtailment alert; credits as built, x the contract's curtail_credit_mult). Fixed contracts are unaffected.

shocks.source: Winter Storm Uri, 13-17 Feb 2021: ERCOT real-time prices at the $9,000/MWh cap for days
